title: Pin or unpin a chat
steps: Click the chat you'd like to pin, then open its menu (right-click the chat, or click the small arrow that appears on it).
Choose how long the pin should last, then click Pin.
To unpin, open the pinned chat's menu and click Unpin. You can pin up to three chats.

source.title: How to pin or unpin a chat

title: Send a file, photo or document
steps: Open the individual or group chat.
Click Attach (the + next to the message box), then choose the type: Document, or Photos & videos.
Pick the file, click Open, then click Send.
You can also drag a file into the chat. Documents can be up to 2 GB.

source.title: How to send media, contacts, or location
